gaps.name: measurement
gaps.risk: calorimetric artifacts can be mistaken for excess heat
gaps.test: matched calibration, raw time series, complete input-output audit

gaps.name: materials_state
gaps.risk: unobserved loading, defects, impurities, and history confound replication
gaps.test: in-run loading diagnostics plus pre/post composition and microscopy

gaps.name: product_balance
gaps.risk: heat claims are disconnected from nuclear products
gaps.test: synchronized neutron, gamma, tritium, helium, activation, and calorimetry

gaps.name: statistics
gaps.risk: optional stopping and multiple comparisons inflate positive findings
gaps.test: preregistration, blinded labels, fixed stopping rules, Bayesian evidence

gaps.name: independent_replication
gaps.risk: protocol and materials differences prevent decisive comparison
gaps.test: shared materials, cross-lab transfer, and independent analysis

gaps.name: technology_threshold
gaps.risk: a real microscopic reaction may not be useful energy technology
gaps.test: net-power, safety, lifecycle, and incumbent comparison thresholds
